class.name: ResonanceProbeExclusion
class.brief_description: Box that skips probe placement inside its volume when parented under a ResonanceProbeVolume.
class.description: Place as a descendant of [ResonanceProbeVolume]. During bake (and editor probe preview), candidates whose world position lies inside this oriented box ([member region_size] in local space) are discarded. Disabled boxes ([member enabled] off) are ignored. Moving, resizing, or enabling a box marks the parent volume bake outdated.

members.member: Local box size in meters (X, Y, Z). Minimum per axis is 0.1.
When false, this box does not exclude probes and is hidden in the editor gizmo.
